title: Concept: Media source element on plaintext HTTP
description: A source element that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The source list decides what the player fetches, so an unauthenticated source can replace the media the customer sees.
applicability: Deployments that render a source element that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The source list decides what the player fetches, so an unauthenticated source can replace the media the customer sees.
